statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-41178 (GO-2026-5158, GHSA-5wrp-cwcj-q835): after an upstream change removed the raw-length check, OpenTelemetry-Go's baggage.Parse fully parses oversized or malformed baggage headers, and the Baggage propagator forwards each parse error to the global error handler, so a remote client can cause CPU and log amplification in a service that extracts inbound baggage. The GitHub advisory lists go.opentelemetry.io/otel/baggage and go.opentelemetry.io/otel/propagation versions 1.41.0 (fixed in 1.42.0) and 1.43.0 (fixed in 1.44.0) as affected: https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-go/security/advisories/GHSA-5wrp-cwcj-q835, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5158, https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-go/pull/7880. Read every published alertmanager-dev package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository: 36 builds, 0.31.1-r0 to the current 0.35.0-r2, each for x86_64 and aarch64. Each package installs two files, /usr/bin/alertmanager and /usr/bin/amtool, statically linked Go programs with no program interpreter, built with CGO_ENABLED=0. The versions below are read from their Go build information and are the same for both programs and both architectures in each build. They list go.opentelemetry.io/otel v1.40.0 in 0.31.1-r0 to 0.31.1-r5; v1.43.0 in 0.31.1-r6 to 0.32.1-r2; v1.44.0 in 0.32.1-r3 to 0.33.1-r3; v1.45.0 in 0.33.1-r5; v1.44.0 in 0.34.0-r0 to 0.34.0-r5; v1.46.0 in 0.34.0-r6 to 0.34.1-r0; v1.47.0 in 0.34.1-r1 to 0.35.0-r2, so builds 0.31.1-r6 to 0.32.1-r2 carry the affected v1.43.0 and no build carries v1.41.0. Checked against the function names the Go linker records in each binary, no build of either program contains any function from the go.opentelemetry.io/otel/baggage package or the Baggage propagator's Extract method. The vulnerable code is not present in any published build.

statements.status_notes: GO-2026-5158 (https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5158, GHSA-5wrp-cwcj-q835) affects go.opentelemetry.io/otel (from 1.41.0 before 1.42.0; from 1.43.0 before 1.44.0). We read the Go module build information embedded in every Go program of all 86 published build-dev packages, 2.6.4-r0 to 2.28.0-r5, on amd64 and arm64; the module is embedded in usr/bin/build. Packages before 2.16.6-r0 embed go.opentelemetry.io/otel v1.40.0, outside the affected range. Packages 2.16.6-r0 to 2.20.0-r4 embed go.opentelemetry.io/otel v1.41.0 or v1.43.0, each inside the affected range. Every Go program in 2.20.0-r5 and in every later package embeds v1.44.0 or a later release outside the affected ranges, so 2.20.0-r5 is the first fixed build-dev package. Version 2.19.1-r1 is listed three times in each index, every entry with the same source commit and installed size as 2.19.1-r0; the copy the repository serves was read.

CVE-2026-41178 (GO-2026-5158, GHSA-5wrp-cwcj-q835): baggage parsing in go.opentelemetry.io/otel (baggage.New, baggage.Parse and propagation.Baggage.Extract) did not cap the raw header length in v1.41.0 and v1.43.0. It is fixed in v1.42.0 and v1.44.0: https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5158, https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-go/security/advisories/GHSA-5wrp-cwcj-q835, https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-go/pull/7880. Read every published external-dns-dev package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository: 33 builds, 0.20.0-r0 to the current 0.24.0-r5, each for x86_64 and aarch64. Each package installs one file, /usr/bin/external-dns, a statically linked Go program built with CGO_ENABLED=0. The program's Go build information lists go.opentelemetry.io/otel v1.37.0 in 0.20.0-r0 to 0.20.0-r3; v1.39.0 in 0.20.0-r4; v1.42.0 in 0.21.0-r0 to 0.21.0-r9; v1.43.0 in 0.21.0-r10; v1.44.0 in 0.21.0-r11 to 0.21.0-r13; v1.45.0 in 0.22.0-r0 to 0.24.0-r4; v1.47.0 in 0.24.0-r5. Build 0.21.0-r10 carries a vulnerable go.opentelemetry.io/otel (v1.43.0); 0.20.0-r0 to 0.21.0-r9 and 0.21.0-r11 to 0.24.0-r5 carry a go.opentelemetry.io/otel release outside the affected versions. The range covers 0.21.0-r10.

CVE-2026-41178 (GO-2026-5158, GHSA-5wrp-cwcj-q835): go.opentelemetry.io/otel's baggage parsing no longer capped the raw header length, so a very large baggage header could cause excessive work. Only 1.41.x and 1.43.x are affected; it is fixed in 1.42.0 and 1.44.0. Sources: https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5158, https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-go/security/advisories/GHSA-5wrp-cwcj-q835, https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-go/pull/7880. Read the Go build information of /usr/bin/metrics-server, the only program the package ships, in every published metrics-server-dev package in the DHI Alpine 3.23 package repository (0.8.1-r0 to 0.9.1-r2, 29 versions, x86_64 and aarch64); both architectures match in every version. 0.8.1-r0 to 0.8.1-r6 use go.opentelemetry.io/otel 1.40.0, outside the affected range; 0.8.1-r7 to 0.8.1-r12 use go.opentelemetry.io/otel 1.43.0, inside the affected range; 0.9.0-r0 and every later build use go.opentelemetry.io/otel 1.44.0 to 1.47.0, which carry the fix.
